source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When mustering, each **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit you add that isn't an **EPIC HERO** and lacks all of these keywords must be given one of them: **KHORNE**, **TZEENTCH**, **NURGLE**, **SLAANESH** or **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**, recorded on your Army Roster.

When a unit that has one of those keywords is given a weapon ability by [Dark Pacts](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts) and passes the Leadership test for it, it also gets a bonus until the phase ends.

If it gained **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**:

- **KHORNE**: its melee attacks score **Critical Hits** on unmodified **Hit rolls** of 5+.
- **TZEENTCH**: its ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
- **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**: its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

If it gained **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**:

- **NURGLE**: its ranged attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
- **SLAANESH**: its melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.
- **CHAOS UNDIVIDED**: its attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
